issues: No PDF program of studies; the catalog is an undated Google Site curriculum handbook (~60 course subpages, grades 6-12, trimester courses). Not crawled; only the site home (with full nav listing every course) and the school's Academic Program page saved. Incomplete: Mathematics lists Pre-Algebra, Algebra I, Geometry, Algebra II, Pre-Calculus, Calculus, Statistics as titles only (only Grade 7 Math has a page); some nav links 404 (e.g. a 'shakespeare' link vs. 'shakespeare-survey'); course pages carry template placeholders for units; a 'Copy of Blank Course Template' page is published. No year on the site, so currency unknown; Google Sites 'Page updated' date is JS-rendered and not captured. Grad requirements: subject-by-subject list found only in the 2022-23 School Profile (outdated; set as grad_requirements_url, not downloaded); the 2026-27 student handbook has only credit thresholds and community service. Phase 2 will need to crawl ~60 Google Site subpages.
